arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Shadow damage infects enemies with {c_important}Shadowblight{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]th{/c} time an enemy receives Shadow damage from you while they are affected by {c_important}Shadowblight{/c}, they take an additional {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} of that damage as Corrupting damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
